name: device-login-permission-lost

graded_by.test: core/internal/ws/device_login_test.go — TestAPolicyReloadEndsADeviceLogin4003AtAttachAndForbiddenAtConnected: 4003 at device_login_attach after the reload, result forbidden and close 4016 at connected, nothing audited

description: Permission is checked again across a long login (OQ5 (a)): at `device_login_attach` the principal must still see the target and hold `session.create` and a join permission, else the socket is closed 4003 (the attach order's code for a principal who may no longer join) and nothing is sent first; at `connected` the core sends C3 `disconnect` and `device_login_result {outcome: forbidden}`, then closes 4016. Neither is audited, as no refused create is.

instances.note: at connected: the permission went with a policy reload
the outcome is `forbidden`, the word the 403 uses
